description: (Na)₂NaTlF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaTlF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaTlF₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.20 Å. Tl is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form TlF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Tl-F bond lengths are 2.17 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Tl atom.
